far_field_sample.reason: The initial six-frame far-field slice was already identified as insufficient in the M3 plan.

limitations: 6 far-field frames span only 1 held-out recordings.
IMG_0644 adds held-out overlap and edge cases but no top-third targets.
The current rule routed 216 of 220 card clusters, so crop inference ran on 98.2% of clusters.
None of the 6 top-third frames changed after crop refinement.
The evaluation has positive examples only, not background-only frames.

method.determinism_digest_scope: final normalized proposal geometry and provenance; timing excluded
method.far_field_frame_definition: at least one reviewed card bounding-box center has normalized y <= 0.330
method.frame_edge_definition: at least one reviewed card bounding box is within 5% of a frame edge
method.matching: descending-IoU one-to-one greedy assignment with stable input-order ties
method.overlap_definition: reviewed bounding-box intersection covers at least 10% of the smaller box
method.small_model_card_definition: square root of reviewed visible polygon area after scale to 432-pixel model input is at most 86.4 pixels
method.supplemental_unmatched_predictions_insid: not counted as false when at least 50% of prediction polygon area is covered
